subject: math

objective.text: Round two-digit measurements to the nearest ten. Use a vertical number line and its halfway point.

explanations.title: Find the two tens
explanations.text: 73 has 7 tens. The tens on each side are 70 and 80. Put them at the bottom and top of the line.

explanations.title: Mark halfway
explanations.text: Halfway between 70 and 80 is 75. Mark it in the middle.

explanations.title: Round to the nearer ten
explanations.text: 73 is less than halfway, so it is closer to 70. 73 milliliters rounds to 70 milliliters.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (S: 73 milliliters is less than halfway...)

explanations.title: About
explanations.text: 'About 70 milliliters' means close to 70, not exactly 70. Rounding gives an about amount.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (About means that 70 milliliters is not the exact amount.)

explanations.title: Numbers that end in 5
explanations.text: A number exactly halfway, like 25, rounds up to the next ten. 25 rounds to 30.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (convention of rounding numbers that end in 5 up)

examples.title: Round 73 milliliters
examples.text: Endpoints 70 and 80. Halfway is 75. 73 is below 75, so it rounds to 70.

examples.title: Round 38 minutes
examples.text: Endpoints 30 and 40. Halfway is 35. 38 is above 35, so 38 minutes rounds to 40 minutes.

questions.text: What number is halfway between 90 and 100?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Halfway on the Number Line (90 and 100)

questions.text: A beaker has 73 milliliters. How many tens are in 73?
What number is halfway between 70 and 80?

Round 73 milliliters to the nearest 10 milliliters.
Round 61 centimeters to the nearest 10 centimeters.
Round 38 minutes to the nearest 10 minutes.
25 grams is exactly halfway between 20 and 30. Round it to the nearest 10 grams.
Container A has 33 milliliters. Which two tens is it between?
A desk is 48 centimeters wide. Round it to the nearest 10 centimeters.
A door is 81 centimeters wide. Round it to the nearest 10 centimeters.
Gym class ends at 10:27 a.m. Round the time to the nearest 10 minutes.
How does marking the halfway point help you round?
